Name: Automatic In-Law Relationship Tags
Author: AirynS
Description:
[size=3]This simple mod shows your relationship with your spouse's family as a short written tag below their name in the social menu. It will only take effect for romanceable characters with friendable family members.

If you prefer your own custom tag for a particular character, player-set tags from NPC Relationship Tags will take priority over Automatic In-Law Relationship Tags.

[/size][size=4]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40276]NPC Relationship Tags[/url]﻿ by mushymato![/size][size=3]
[size=3][size=3]
[/size][/size][size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size][size=3][size=3]

Automatic Friend Relationship Tags has one config option that affects all characters: "Include 'In-Law' in Tag". If set to true, characters will be tagged as "[relation]-in-law" (eg. "mother-in-law"), while if it is set to false, they will be tagged simply as "[relation]" (eg. "mother").

It also has individual toggles for each character included in the mod, grouped by vanilla NPCs, Ridgeside Village, Sunberry Village, and Visit Mount Vapius.

[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][size=3][size=3]

Automatic Friend Relationship Tags is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8146]Platonic Partners and Friendships[/url]'s commitment ceremony and roommate options, although it will use the same language for your in-laws regardless of whether you have a spouse, a platonic partner, or a roommate.

It is compatible with and will take priority over [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40809]Automatic Friend Relationship Tags[/url].

It is also compatible with the following custom NPCs:

[/size][/size][list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿ (Alissa, Anton, Blair, Corine, Kiarra, Ysabelle, Shiro & Zayne)[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village [/url](Elias)[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url]﻿ (Aster)[/size]
[/list][/size][/size]
[/size][size=3][i]Why these NPCs? Why not SVE?

[/i]Because I wanted to cover these NPCs. I don't offer SVE compatibility.[b]

[/b]Untested with polyamory mods. It may only tag your current spouse's in-laws or it may tag the in-laws of all spouses.[/size][size=5][b]

Permissions[/b][/size][size=3]

If you would like to translate this mod, you may as long as AI is not used for the translation and only the translated i18n file is uploaded.

If you would like to use my code to create a version of this mod for other custom NPCs, you may as long as I am credited and there is a link back to this mod.[/size]
